description.en: A 5.2-acre deck park built over Woodall Rodgers Freeway, connecting Uptown to the Dallas Arts District with lawns, food trucks, and a children's park.

photos.alt: Visitors relaxing on the great lawn at Klyde Warren Park with downtown Dallas skyscrapers in the background
photos.credit: City of Dallas Park and Recreation

description.en: A 277-acre National Historic Landmark and the largest collection of Art Deco exposition architecture in the United States, home to the State Fair of Texas.

photos.alt: The Fair Park esplanade lined with Art Deco buildings and reflecting pools at dusk
photos.credit: City of Dallas Park and Recreation

description.en: A 1,254-acre park surrounding a reservoir lake, with a 9.3-mile trail loop, the historic Bath House Cultural Center, and views of the downtown skyline.

photos.alt: Cyclists on the paved trail along the shoreline of White Rock Lake at sunrise
photos.credit: City of Dallas Park and Recreation
